about: Video 002 The Last Request: the shot list (1-3 s each, a new action every 2-3 s), shared by the picture (engine/src/scenes/lastrequest/) and the sound (engine/tools/mix_lastrequest.py). Times in seconds. transitions: the eerie cut at that time (blink = eyelids closing to black and opening, smear = smearing into darkness, heart = a cut on a heartbeat, glass = a dissolve through rain on glass, glassSlow = the same, slower (0.8 s), flash = a lightning-flash cut).

shots.why: You think you're not being punished...: he runs through the night rain, late, splashing through puddles
...for your sins?: the bus pulls away as he reaches the stop
Look closely: a slow push into his soaked, faceless silhouette, standing still as the crowd rushes past
deprived of your Qiyam al-Layl: 3 a.m., he tosses and turns in bed
he sits up and grabs his phone; the prayer mat in the corner goes darker
your daily Qur'an recitation: he walks past the shelf, the mushaf's dust thickening; he doesn't look
your sunnah prayers: he walks past the masjid door in the rain as men go in; warm light spills out; he keeps walking into the dark
your tongue no longer remembers Allah: his prayer beads slip off the nightstand and scatter across the floor
your heart is slowly closing off: the colour drains from his room in a wave; the clock races; warm light leaks out of the window like smoke; the money ticks down
the plant on the windowsill wilts in time-lapse; his food goes cold
So when are you gonna wake up?: he collapses onto the bed

after 'wake up?': no text for ~1.3 s, never dark: a slow push-in on him lying on the bed in the dark room, rain on the window behind him, his phone's light fading; then a slow dissolve through rain on glass
63:10 And spend...: the bank screen, work notifications piling up; his hands on his head
before death approaches one of you: he walks home alone in the heavy rain
his phone drops into a puddle and cracks
and he says...: he stumbles and collapses on the wet street (from a distance, side view)
the hospital: the camera moves along the bed rail; the heartbeat on the monitor slowing; heavier rain
...if only You would delay me: the line goes flat
for a brief term: the empty bed; the curtain moves in the draft (no being is shown)
his father sits on his bed in the dark, holding his prayer beads, shoulders shaking
his phone buzzes on the mat ('12 missed calls'); his little brother picks it up and looks at it
his little brother takes the dusty mushaf off the shelf and blows the dust off
so I would give charity: his father opens his laptop, the big balance still on screen, and slowly closes it
...his wallet is put into a box with his things
...and be of the righteous: his kufi is hung on the door as the light goes out
63:11 But never will Allah delay a soul: two lightning flashes reveal the empty room
when its time has come: alongside the carriers walking through the rain
feet splashing in the mud
umbrellas, men walking in a line
at the grave: soil falling; a man holds a lantern
And Allah is Aware of what you do: men round the grave raise their hands in du'a in the rain
a man sprinkles water on the grave; hands smooth the soil
the camera tracks slowly past rows of graves; wind blows the rain sideways; crows on a wall fly off
the men turn and leave one by one, footsteps in the mud
fog rolls in over the grave as the camera pulls far back
